body: Scan WindImpulses handles at stride0x4c/offset0x48 followed by WindImpulseCylinders at stride0x48/offset0x38. Return whether UID matches.
required_wrapper_effect: The original wrapper default-constructs a temporary handle and increments shared global0x148129b6c before resolving the reference argument. The restored struct constructor and exported allocator now preserve this effect in generated wrappers.

shared_constructor.implementation: Default constructor calls one exported FortniteGame allocator shared across modules. It returns the current uint32 UID and increments with 32-bit wraparound, without locking. Copy/assignment remain ordinary value copies.
shared_constructor.initialization: Zero-initialized PE .data tail: RVA0x8129b6c falls beyond .data SizeOfRawData, inside VirtualSize. Runtime capture contains UID7; that is observed current state, not the initial seed.
shared_constructor.counter_abi: uint32 arithmetic preserves machine wraparound; int32 UID retains original bits. An exported allocator avoids per-module disconnected counters.

reference_scan.scope: Two captured executable sections; RIP-relative candidates with 0/1/4-byte trailing immediates. Candidates need instruction validation; no claim of indirect-reference completeness.

signature_policy: The reflected const reference input is restored before snippet validation, preserving Blueprint input semantics and allowing UHT-generated temporary handles.
blueprint_exposure: Restore BlueprintType on the struct inputs required by the original Blueprint-callable functions. Shipping tables omit editor metadata; callable signatures establish exposure. Native member layout and property exposure remain unchanged.
